config.security_model: semi-honest independent computation parties, at most one passively corrupt; malicious client consistency and format checks
config.profile_noise: independent discrete Laplace contribution from each computation party, added inside MPC
config.authentication: same-secret MPC equality against distributed credential shares, not OPAQUE/PAKE implementation
config.suite_scope: small synthetic actual cryptographic protocol and state-machine feasibility checks, not scale or production security audit

client_randomness: secrets.randbelow, independent per bit and operation
privacy_noise: q=ceil(exp(-epsilon/4)*2^64)/2^64; difference of two exact rational geometric draws at each party
public_request_binding: domain-separated HMAC-SHA256 of local envelope under each party private 256-bit key; never unkeyed share hashes
